from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689824/attempts/9d615e3a66d9447e8803eb583e82b2e3/system/state/workspace/programs/task-9c84485b.py')

source='''def transform(grid):
    """Mirror horizontally and extend the image as flipped/original/flipped vertically."""
    rows = [list(row) for row in grid]
    horizontal = [list(reversed(row)) + list(row) for row in rows]
    return list(reversed(horizontal)) + horizontal + list(reversed(horizontal))
'''
p.write_text(source)
